steps.title: Discover
steps.subtitle: Audit the search landscape.
steps.copy: Clarify the business goals, review crawlability, map competitors and establish an honest search baseline.

steps.title: Plan
steps.subtitle: Connect intent to the right pages.
steps.copy: Group keywords by intent, map the page architecture and prioritize an achievable content and technical roadmap.

steps.title: Optimize
steps.subtitle: Make relevance easier to understand.
steps.copy: Improve on-page structure, internal links and technical foundations. Shape useful content around the queries that matter.

steps.title: Measure
steps.subtitle: Turn evidence into the next decision.
steps.copy: Review search visibility and organic engagement, document changes and refine the next cycle using recorded evidence.

launch.title: Start with search intent
launch.copy: Map priority queries to the sitemap. Define page purpose, content briefs and internal-link relationships before design decisions harden.

launch.title: Make the site search-ready
launch.copy: Check crawl access, canonical signals, metadata, redirects and measurement. Keep staging separate from the launch-ready site.

launch.title: Validate, then improve
launch.copy: Check index coverage and search visibility, resolve early technical issues and use the first performance signals to prioritize the next work.
